Class ControllerFactoryImpl

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.controller.ControllerFactoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ControllerFactory, Serializable, Remote
public class ControllerFactoryImpl extends UnicastRemoteObject implements ControllerFactory, Remote
Implementation of the ControllerFactory interface using RMI. This factory is responsible for creating and exporting VirtualController instances that clients can use to interact with the game remotely.

Internally, it delegates controller creation to a shared MultiGameController instance which manages multiple concurrent game sessions.
